title: neottia elata
intro: Neottia elata, commonly known as the tall orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Neottia elata include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional Chinese medicine.
